sources.title: Integration Approach
sources.summary: Solvantis has native capabilities for Xero accounting, Shopify product, inventory, order, customer, return and loyalty flows, Cin7 inventory, and connected Google and Meta marketing analysis. Scale and Enterprise include supported standard 3PL workflows. Provider-specific connector development, third-party fees and unusually complex warehouse processes are assessed during discovery and may be separately scoped and quoted.

sources.title: Onboarding and Support
sources.summary: Starter and Core use self onboarding with guided setup, import templates and Help. Scale and Enterprise include White Glove onboarding within an agreed scope. Starter includes email support, Core adds a local business-hours helpdesk, Scale includes priority local support, and Enterprise includes a dedicated account lead and contracted service levels.

sources.title: Plans, Pricing and Current Offer
sources.summary: Starter is advertised from $59 per month with eligible Connected Payments volume, or $99 per month without Connected Payments. Core is $349 per month, Scale is $749 per month and Enterprise starts from $1,999 per month. Prices are AUD excluding GST. AI Automation is available on every plan and generative or agentic actions use separately purchased credits. The current introductory offer provides Starter for 3 months for a one-time $1 payment, followed by normal Starter pricing unless cancelled.

sources.title: Solvantis Product and Fit
sources.summary: Solvantis brings inventory, purchasing, in-store point of sale, customer management, wholesale, online commerce and business analysis together for Australian retailers. It is a strong fit for teams that want shared product and stock visibility across one or many locations, with deeper planning and control available as operations grow.

sources.title: Retail Use Cases
sources.summary: Solvantis supports single-store and multi-location retailers that need coordinated stock, purchasing, point of sale, customer orders, loyalty, wholesale or online sales. Common use cases include shared product control across locations, replenishment planning, combined in-store and online operations, and business analysis grounded in retail activity.

sources.title: Shopify and Loyalty
sources.summary: Yes. Solvantis can run one loyalty program across its POS and a connected Shopify store. Supported Shopify customer, order, return and loyalty flows keep eligible in-store and online activity in the same customer loyalty experience. The exact migration and launch setup is confirmed during onboarding; separate third-party loyalty platforms may require discovery.
